notes: The supplied quantifying determiner *any* joins the nominal expression it determines and is never the head; no `כֹּל` or other morpheme stands in the phrase to license it (rule 15).
`בִּי` is the verbless clause's predicate and takes the construction-supplied copula with its presentative dummy, headed on the preposition (rules 49, 20).
Both construct chains are rendered attributively, and the single supplied *the* of the second is the construct noun's whichever English order the ASV writes (rules 28, 29).
The marginal *Or, way of pain* was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
